engine.pascalEditor: Not used in this demo. @pascal-app/viewer 1.1.3 requires React 19, React Three Fiber and its own scene graph; vendoring a pinned commit, converting our plan JSON into Pascal's model, self-hosting furniture (runtime CDN is not allowed) and keeping a WebGL path would have delayed a working public demo. This viewer is purpose-built in three.js (WebGL) against our blueprint JSON. Pascal remains a candidate for a later editor evaluation.
